description: This is an HTML test file that sets up accessibility ARIA property tests for a file-label-owned-combobox with an owned listbox. The file includes script references for testing harnesses and accessibility testing, and defines a test scenario for verifying ARIA properties like name descriptions across multiple accessibility APIs.
